answer: An agent marketplace allows one active job per identity and requires $100 escrow per identity. Deposits are bound to public keys, so accounts named yarrow, canyon, and dune need $300 total; the same funds cannot back all three. Escrow unlocks only 30 days after the last job finishes. Each additional fake worker therefore ties up another $100. At a 12% annual borrowing rate, even an instant job incurs about $0.99 in financing cost before withdrawal; longer jobs cost more.
